title: Director of Quality
text:
**Director of Quality – Aerospace Manufacturing**
**Oklahoma City, OK**
**Extremely Competitive Pay**
-
*Dependent on Experience*
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced quality leader to oversee and advance our quality management program within a growing aerospace manufacturing organization. This position plays a critical role in ensuring product integrity, maintaining customer and regulatory compliance, and driving continuous improvement throughout the company. Working closely with manufacturing, engineering, and executive leadership, the Director of Quality will lead quality initiatives, develop high-performing teams, strengthen organizational processes, and promote a culture of accountability and operational excellence. The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge with proven leadership skills and a commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality results.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Implement and maintain the company quality system in coordination with the Management Representative.
* Report on the performance of the quality system for review and as a basis for improvement of the quality system.
* Have knowledge and understanding of the standards and customer requirements against which the quality system is developed, maintained, and implemented.
* Provide leadership to subordinates, establishing goals and development plans to meet the strategic direction of the organization.
* Determine and enforce -- through functional groups - quality requirements in accordance with real company needs, based on current regulations and state-of-the art product development.
* Develop audit plans, select, and evaluate auditors, document non-conformance(s) and report non-conformances to management.
* Manage subordinate personnel and ensure proper documentation and methods used are according to the Quality Management System.
* Ensure employees are properly trained to perform their job duties in the manner expected, according to their specific job description.
* Establishes and maintains an effective system of communications throughout the organization.
* Represents the organization with major customers, shareholders, the financial community, and the public.
* Monitor and evaluate subordinate personnel updating the Management Representative and Human Resources to have the Employee Skills Matrix reflect accurately the training and skills of subordinates.
* Administer the company quality program in accordance with customer and company requirements.
* Ensure corrective and preventive actions are issued, responded, and completed.
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives for scrap reduction, reducing variation and waste, increasing profit and to improve product quality.
* Organize and promote companywide quality improvement efforts.
* Liaison with external parties on matters relating to the quality management system.
* Maintain the system for calibration of inspection, tools, and equipment for conformance to product specifications.
* Research and analyze data such as customer design proposals, specifications, quality requirements, and manuals to determine feasibility or processes or application and company’s ability to inspect product at the required stages of manufacture.
* Plan and direct quality activities and establishes QA priorities for keeping effective production operations and cost factors.
* Assist engineering in organizing and planning Quality Planning Meetings.
* Read and understand technical and non-technical documents that relate to contracts, purchasing, product design, manufacturing, and test. This includes the ability to interface with both technical and non-technical personnel.
* Evaluate, study, standardize and improve procedures for the assurance of quality, reliability, safety, and efficiency.
* Assess techniques for examining, questioning, evaluating, and reporting.
* Analyze inspection data to determine product conformance and process capability.
* Prepare composite reports from individual reports of subordinates.
* Maintain training records, coordinate with upper management to determine training requirements.
* Issue written and oral instructions.
* Assign duties and examine work for exactness, neatness, and conformance product specifications, policies and procedures.
* Coordinate and plan meetings with departments to develop documentation to support compliance to the applicable standards.
* Ensure nonconforming product is controlled in accordance with the company's quality requirements.
* Monitor metrics associated with the Cost of Quality.
* Initiate NMR’s and DMR's for product found to be nonconforming.
* Ensure employees are properly trained to perform their job duties in the manner expected, according to their specific job description.
* Ensure employees observe the safety rules and regulations and wear the required safety equipment (PPE).
* Assist employees in using the proper tools and equipment to monitor conformance to specifications and ensure equipment is calibrated and maintained.
* Ensure proper documentation and methods used are according to the Quality Management System.
* Support the Quality Management System to assure compliance to quality, industrial and government standards and regulations and customer requirements.
* Adhere to all Quality Management System procedures and instructions.
* Maintain a safe, clean, and orderly work environment.
* Observe the safety rules and regulations and wear the required safety equipment.

**Additional Benefits We Offer**

* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) with Company Match
* Company Sponsored Life-Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays

**Qualifications**
**Job Qualifications**
**Physical Requirements**
While performing the duties of the job, the employee is required to stand; walk; sit; use hands/fingers to handle/feel; reach with hands and arms; climb; balance; stoop; kneel; crouch; crawl; reach; pull; balance; carry; handle. The employee may occasionally lift or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to focus.
 
 
**Education And/or Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 4-10 years of related experience in manufacturing.
* Previous experience working with Lockheed Martin is required

**Work Authorization Requirement**
This position is subject to
**ITAR regulations.**
